raw_segments.text: If you will want not, time and place will be fruitfully offered.
There is nothing done if you return the conqueror.
Then am I the prisoner, and his bed my jail, from the loathed warmth whereof deliver me
and supply the place for your labor.
Your wife, so I would say affectionate servant, goneral.
O, indistinguished space of woman's will, a plot upon her virtuous husband's life,
Here in the sands thee I'll rake up, the post unsanctified of murderous lechers, and
in the mature time, with this ungracious paper strike the sight of the death practice duke.
For him tis well that of thy death and business I can tell.
